# `⍀` — Expand / Scan first

`N⍀Y` expands first-axis cells.

```apl
1 0 1⍀2 2⍴⍳4       ⍝ [1 2 ⋄ 0 0 ⋄ 3 4]
```

`f⍀Y` scans down the first axis.

```apl
+⍀2 3⍴⍳6           ⍝ [1 2 3 ⋄ 5 7 9]
```

`S f⍀Y` supplies a seed.

```apl
10+⍀2 2⍴⍳4         ⍝ [11 12 ⋄ 14 16]
```

Counts, seeds and `⍤[K]` follow [`\`](backslash.qmd).
